note: What a server sends to change one thing about a spell already in a unit's slot. Which thing is settled by the kind below, and each kind carries its own shape.

bits.name: summonerSpell
bits.note: Set where the slot is a summoner slot rather than one of the unit's own.

bits.name: unknown
bits.note: Purpose undetermined. A server leaves these as it found them, so they carry values it never wrote for this message.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: Which thing about the spell is being changed, and so which shape follows. Only a change of name has been observed.

fields.name: name
fields.note: The name the client loads the spell under. Written out in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above. Every payload observed names a change of name; a payload naming another kind carries a shape this specification does not record.
